title: AW27 Women's Assortment and Pricing Strategy
summary: Plan AW27 womenswear for low growth: depth in coats and suiting, shallow statement buys, full price on what is new.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fashion is expected to remain in low single-digit growth in 2027, with markdown risk from excess stock<sup>[1]</sup>
- Resale is expected to grow two to three times faster than first-hand fashion through 2027<sup>[1]</sup>
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027; since 19 July 2026 large companies may not destroy certain unsold apparel<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Assortment
sections.body:
| Tier | What goes in it |
|---|---|
| Core (about half) | Tailoring, knits in mushroom, tinted black, greyed blue |
| Seasonal (about a third) | Violet and bordeaux coats, velvet, skirt suits |
| Statement (the rest) | Lace, lurex, teddy coats |

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body:
- Full price on double-faced and technical coats.
- Value on merino basics.

commercial_implications: - Plan resale and rework routes in the EU.

sources.title: Fashion: 2027, the year growth will finally have to be profitable
